# kion_custom_variable_override (Resource)

Manages a Kion Custom Variable Override.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_custom_variable_override" "example" {
  # Required
  custom_variable_id = "example"
  entity_id          = "example"
  entity_type        = "example"

  # Optional
  # last_updated = "example"
  # value_list   = []
  # value_map    = {}
  # value_string = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `custom_variable_id` (String) The ID of the custom variable.
- `entity_id` (String) The ID of the entity.
- `entity_type` (String) The type of the entity.

### Optional

- `last_updated` (String) The last time this resource was updated.
- `value_list` (List of String) The value of the custom variable override as a list.
- `value_map` (Map of String) The value of the custom variable override as a map.
- `value_string` (String) The value of the custom variable override as a string.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the Custom Variable Override.
